j.freqMod.init: MOD DEPTH is at 0, and that knob scales everything arriving at FREQ MOD. Turn MOD DEPTH up to hear this cable.

j.att1.att.1=0: The ATT 1 knob is at 0, so nothing comes out of this jack. Turn ATT 1 up.

j.att2.init: The ATT 2 knob is at 0, so nothing comes out of this jack. Turn ATT 2 up.
